adjuster_brief:
## Escalation Brief — Claim CLM-2026-001

**Plot:** P-0142, Makueni County, 2025 Long Rains
**Farmer:** Wanjiru Mwangi
**Crop:** Maize (flowering stage)

### Index Outcome
Seasonal rainfall of 341 mm exceeds the 30th-percentile trigger of 290 mm. The index does **not** pay (Policy §4.2.1).

### Photo Evidence
Two photos accepted (one rejected as near-duplicate of CLM-2025-987). Both Gemini passes agree on **SEVERE** damage:
- Leaf rolling: 3/3 — tightly rolled leaves across the field
- Canopy senescence: 2/3 — premature yellowing
- Soil cracking: visible — dry cracked soil between maize rows
- Damage type: drought

### Independent Evidence
- **Dry spell:** 21 consecutive days (12 Mar – 1 Apr) overlapping the flowering window
- **NDVI anomaly:** z = −1.9 (below stress cutoff of −1.5), confirming satellite-detected vegetation stress

### Concordance
**PHENOLOGICAL_BASIS_RISK_GAP** — the seasonal rainfall total masked a critical-window drought that caused verifiable field-level damage (Policy §5.3). This claim meets the escalation criteria under §7.1.4.

### Recommendation
**ESCALATE** to senior adjuster for payout consideration under the basis-risk review process.

farmer_messages.en: Dear Wanjiru, we have received and reviewed the photos from your maize plot P-0142. Our assessment shows significant drought damage during the flowering stage. Although the seasonal rainfall for your area was above the insurance trigger level, the evidence shows your field experienced a prolonged dry spell at a critical time. Your claim has been escalated for further review by a senior claims officer. You will hear from us within 5 working days. Reference: CLM-2026-001.
farmer_messages.hi: प्रिय वंजीरू, हमने आपके मक्का प्लॉट P-0142 की तस्वीरें प्राप्त और समीक्षा कर ली हैं। हमारे आकलन में फूल आने के चरण के दौरान काफ़ी सूखे का नुकसान दिखाई देता है। हालांकि आपके क्षेत्र में मौसमी वर्षा बीमा ट्रिगर स्तर से ऊपर थी, साक्ष्य दर्शाते हैं कि आपके खेत ने एक महत्वपूर्ण समय पर लंबे सूखे का अनुभव किया। आपका दावा वरिष्ठ दावा अधिकारी द्वारा आगे की समीक्षा के लिए भेजा गया है। आपको 5 कार्य दिवसों में सूचित किया जाएगा। संदर्भ: CLM-2026-001।
farmer_messages.sw: Wanjiru mpendwa, tumepokea na kukagua picha kutoka shamba lako la mahindi P-0142. Tathmini yetu inaonyesha uharibifu mkubwa wa ukame wakati wa hatua ya kutoa maua. Ingawa mvua ya msimu katika eneo lako ilikuwa juu ya kiwango cha bima, ushahidi unaonyesha kuwa shamba lako lilipata kipindi kirefu cha ukame wakati muhimu. Dai lako limeongezwa kwa ukaguzi zaidi na afisa mkuu wa madai. Utasikia kutoka kwetu ndani ya siku 5 za kazi. Rejea: CLM-2026-001.
